metadata.case_name: FU YUK-MING v. LEE FOOK-CHOI AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: A fracture of the base of the skull with intracerebral haematoma
source: A fracture of the base of the skull with intracerebral haematoma

injuries.description: A fracture of the shaft to the left femur
source: A fracture of the shaft to the left femur

injuries.description: A fracture and dislocation of the right elbow
source: A fracture and dislocation of the right elbow
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the elbow or forearm

injuries.description: A degloved injury of the right ankle (dorsum of the right foot skin stripped off, lower end of the fibula and the cuneiform bones peeled off and crushed)
source: He had a degloved injury of the dorsum of the right foot in that the skin was stripped off an area of 7" x 4". The lower end of the fibula and the cuneiform bones were peeled off and crushed.
A degloved injury of the right ankle

injuries.description: Laceration of the left cornea with resulting corneal scarring
source: He has at present corneal scarring on the lower 1/3 of the cornea.
injuries.icd_description: Ocular laceration without prolapse or loss of intraocular tissue, unilateral

injuries.description: Paralysis of the right third cranial nerve resulting in a divergent squint; extensive brain damage causing partial spastic paralysis and epilepsy
injuries.body_part: cranial nerve / brain / right arm and leg
source: The brain injury caused a nerve palsy resulting in a divergent squint in the right eye.
Dr. Wedderburn found that he had extensive brain damage affecting his memory and intellect and causing a partial spastic paralysis of the right leg and arm.
The brain injury, he found, had given rise to a form of epilepsy.
injuries.icd_description: Diffuse injury of multiple parts of brain

manifestations.description: Extensive brain damage affecting his memory and intellect
Partial spastic paralysis of the right leg and arm
A form of epilepsy arising from the brain injury (has minor attacks and may wet his clothes)
Paralysis of the right third cranial nerve with resultant divergent squint and impairment of vision
Corneal scarring on the lower 1/3 of the cornea
Multiple vision requiring the wearing of an eye patch
Some stiffness of movement of healed fractures
Requires a stick and the assistance of another person in order to walk
Marked impairment in memory and intelligence; mental dullness
Needs to be told to pass urine; when he fails to remember a minor attack of epilepsy results causing incontinence
Cannot put food in the bowl; needs food to be handed to him
Pain from the scar left by a tracheotomy
He will need continuous attention and substantial help from others to cope with daily life
Reduced expectation of life to about the age of 35 or 40

treatments_received: brain operation to remove the haematoma
temporal paramedian tarsorrhaphy (stitching of the eyelids)
skeletal traction for the left femur

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Deprived of almost all that gives joy to life - of the sports natural to a youth

losses.category: Loss of ability to pursue education
losses.description: Deprived of all intellectual endeavour and inability to pursue normal education and studies
Deprived of all normal social activity and the company of boys and girls of his own age
Deprived of all prospects of a happy marriage
Will never be in a position to work; earning capacity is nil
Corneal scarring on the lower 1/3 of the cornea and scars from surgery (including tracheotomy and grafting)
Needs continuous attention and substantial help from others to cope with daily life
Requires a stick and assistance of another person in order to walk

comparable_cases.injury_description: A woman in her mid thirties rendered incapable of further work; rendered a simpleton; could not get about unaided; symptoms suggesting epilepsy

comparable_cases.case_name: NG Kam v. TSANG Tak-kuen & Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: A man of 48 who suffered head injuries and sundry abrasions and fractured ribs; virtually a human wreck with personality change and occasional incontinence requiring constant attention
